messages:
recruiter-emma: Candidate (M. Alvarez) just DM'd: they need a live American Sign Language interpreter for the interviews and also asked if we offer short-term childcare reimbursements for a single interview day. Their morning flight is fine but interpreter request is the main ask. Can we arrange both same-day?

paul-peopleops: We can. We use BrightBridge for ASL on-demand — same-day bookings possible but need panel confirmation for a 10am start. Childcare: we have a candidate childcare stipend policy (up to $100 for same-day care). They need to submit receipts after. I'll note process.

luke-hiringmgr: Panel is okay to accommodate ASL. What does the setup look like? Will interpreter join Zoom or be in-person? 

accessibility-bot: Vendor note: BrightBridge ASL can join as a 3rd-party on Zoom or be onsite. For in-person, vendor ETA ~45 mins; for remote, they can join instantly. Cost: company covers vendor fee for interviews.

ana-it: If interpreter joins remote, we need to ensure low-latency video layout and that the interpreter video remains pinned. I'll create a Zoom room with interpreter layout and a back-up Teams link. Also can provide a loaner with higher bandwidth hotspot (LOANER-8820) if candidate prefers to come in and use onsite network.

sarah-panel: I can pin the interpreter video if remote. If on-site, please ensure a dedicated monitor in the room so the candidate can see the interpreter clearly. I'm flexible on times — earliest I can start is 10:15.

paul-peopleops: Action items: 1) Book BrightBridge ASL for 10:00-12:30 (tentative) 2) Reserve Interview Room C with second monitor 10:00-13:00 3) Flag childcare stipend ready (candidate to send receipts to people-ops@redwood.ai) 4) LOANER-8820 on hold at reception if candidate wants onsite.

facilities-bot: Room hold placed: Interview Room C, 09:45-13:15. Second monitor and HDMI adapter requested. Reception will hold LOANER-8820 at 09:30. Parking voucher reserved up to $25.

recruiting-bot: ATS note: add "ASL-request" tag; mark childcare-stipend eligible; note loaner LOANER-8820 reserved.

recruiter-emma: I told candidate we'll prioritize a remote ASL interpreter for the first two interviews and can switch to onsite interpreter if they arrive. Candidate also asked whether they can take a 15-minute private break between panels for personal care 94 that's fine.

paul-peopleops: Confirmed: 15-minute private break allowed. Candidate to email receipts for childcare to people-ops@redwood.ai with subject "Childcare Reimbursement - Alvarez". BrightBridge booking pending confirmation; I'll update when booked.
